seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Single horizontal mirror axis (wall row block A); pieces on a 3x3-block grid; yellow targets; gray reflections at row 2A-b for piece blocks above the axis (clipped, skipped on piece blocks).
Selection = 0 in hole centres; ACTION5 cycles axis -> pieces (sorted by min block) -> axis; A1/A2 move selection up/down one block, A3/A4 move pieces sideways; pieces are blocked by bounds/other pieces, the axis only by bounds.
Render: layers wall<target<reflection<piece, first solid wins else topmost hole fill; re-extract walls/players as 4-conn comps of own cells plus all 0 cells, ranked by bbox; targets per sprite.
Hidden state = full model, reused only when the incoming state equals the last output. The turn-order/counter hypothesis was not needed: it also passes 30/30 stateless.
Unconfirmed: wrap from the last piece back to the axis, axis behaviour at board edges, piece cycle order after pieces move.
